# Auto-generated by Agentic Company OS — Cross-Domain Contract Synchronizer
# Contract: Fitness Project Cross-Domain API Contract (v1.0.0)
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
from uuid import UUID
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

class Exercise(BaseModel):
    """Modello sincronizzato per gli esercizi fitness (FastAPI <-> SwiftUI)"""
    model_config = ConfigDict(
        populate_by_name=True,
        from_attributes=True,
    )

    id: UUID = Field(..., description="Identificativo univoco UUID")
    name: str = Field(..., description="Nome dell'esercizio")
    muscle_group: str = Field(..., alias="muscleGroup", description="Gruppo muscolare target")
    gif_url: str = Field(..., alias="gifUrl", description="URL dell'animazione dimostrativa")
    equipment: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Attrezzatura richiesta opzionale")
    created_at: datetime = Field(..., alias="createdAt", description="Timestamp di creazione")

class UserProfile(BaseModel):
    """Profilo biometrico e anagrafico dell'utente fitness"""
    model_config = ConfigDict(
        populate_by_name=True,
        from_attributes=True,
    )

    id: UUID = Field(..., description="UUID utente")
    name: str = Field(..., description="Nome completo")
    email: str = Field(..., description="Indirizzo email")
    age: int = Field(..., description="Età in anni")
    weight_kg: float = Field(..., alias="weightKg", description="Peso corporeo in kg")
    height_cm: float = Field(..., alias="heightCm", description="Altezza in cm")
